items.q: Willie (Inaudible) Smith -- all the top men in there, you know.

ctx.x: That happened one night back in the Charlie Johnson days (inaudible). That's when Fletcher had that tremendous band at the Roseland.
Willie (Inaudible) Smith -- all the top men in there, you know. His wife called me to come down. Coleman didn't show up that night.
